text: {"location":"the bounds check in nth_char","cause":"The condition allows n == len(s), but valid string indexes stop at len(s) - 1, so s[2] is out of range for 'ab'.","change":"Use a strict upper bound so the function only indexes when n is less than len(s).","verification":"The failing case nth_char('ab', 2) should return '' because index 2 is not valid for a two-character string.","applicable_if":"0 <= n <= len(s)"}

obj.cause: The condition allows n == len(s), but valid string indexes stop at len(s) - 1, so s[2] is out of range for 'ab'.
obj.change: Use a strict upper bound so the function only indexes when n is less than len(s).
obj.verification: The failing case nth_char('ab', 2) should return '' because index 2 is not valid for a two-character string.
